gse244832.allowed_use: Donor-compatible external-development accessibility-profile or transductive ATAC diagnostics only. RNA and ATAC are different aliquots and never cell-paired.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 peaks, cells, ATAC values, labels, normalization, or calibration may enter a model scored on GSE244832.

gse289173.allowed_use: No cell-state mapping use because the sealed row universe is RNA-only. Any variant diagnostic would be sequence-only and cannot independently predict signed gene effects.
gse289173.model_access: No cell-state labels or eQTL/ieQTL outcomes are available to fitting.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-fold local sequence-to-accessibility training. For the registered profile baseline, average predictions across outer-training cells within each frozen cell state and repeat that sequence-only cell-state profile across held donors.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors define peaks, binary cell targets, cell-state aggregation, early stopping, or calibration. Held-donor ATAC cannot enter inference.

local_model_roster.transductive_limit: The native 32-dimensional embedding exists only for cells represented by output columns during fitting; held-cell embedding scores are structurally unavailable.

public_tutorial_objects.policy: Do not initialize MASLD runs from these cell-specific output heads. They are not general pretrained checkpoints and their weight terms are undeclared.

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units. Cells are model output tasks, not biological replicates.
rules.genomic_split: Sequence rows use held merged genomic blocks with a 1344-bp boundary buffer; random peak splits from the tutorial are prohibited.
rules.profile_fixture: Before scheduling, prove that the adapter emits finite donor-by-cell-state peak profiles using sequence and training-frozen state aggregation only, with no held-donor ATAC input.
rules.sealed_chronology: Every local artifact and prediction hash must predate outcome joining.
